camel_example: aliyun ims ListApplicationAssignmentsForPrincipal --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --MaxResults 20 --PrincipalName 'user@example.onaliyun.com' --PrincipalType user
description_en: Lists the application assignment records for a specified principal
description_zh: 列出指定身份主体的应用分配记录
name: ListApplicationAssignmentsForPrincipal

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of query results. This parameter is not required for the first API call
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。
首次调用 API 不需要该字段
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The principal name of the RAM user or the role name.

User principal name: The format is `<username>@<account-id>.onaliyun.com`. You can obtain it by calling the `GetUser` or `ListUsers` API operation.
Role name: You can obtain it by calling the RAM `ListRoles` API operation
parameters.help_zh:
RAM 用户主体名称或角色名称。

用户主体名称：格式为 `<username> @ <account-id>.onaliyun.com`，可通过调用`GetUser`或`ListUsers` API 查询。
角色名称：可通过调用 RAM `ListRoles` API 查询
parameters.name: principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the principal to which the application is assigned.

user: The principal is a RAM user. In this case, PrincipalName must be the user principal name.
role: The principal is a RAM role. In this case, PrincipalName must be the role name
parameters.help_zh:
应用分配的目标主体类型。

user：主体类型为 RAM 用户，此时 PrincipalName 必须是用户主体名称。
role：主体类型为 RAM 角色，此时 PrincipalName 必须是角色名称
parameters.name: principal_type

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en: This parameter is returned only when the response is truncated. To retrieve the remaining results, use the value of NextToken in the next call
NextToken.description_zh: 仅当内容被截断时该参数存在。若需要继续调用此接口获取后续内容，使用 NextToken 获取截断后的内容
